visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Merged Result Is Never Copied Back
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array 38 27 43 3 9 82 10 should come out sorted, but it is printed unchanged.

solution.explanation: The merge builds its result in a temporary array. Unless that result is copied back into a at the right position, the original array is never modified and the sort has no visible effect.
